description: The battlefield after 18 days of war. Bodies everywhere. Smoke rising. The Pandava women (Draupadi, Kunti, Uttara, Subhadra) and Kaurava women (Gandhari, widows) walk among the dead, mourning. Stri Parva — the Lament.

vn_backdrop_notes.lighting: Gray overcast sky. Ash and smoke.
vn_backdrop_notes.note: The aesthetic must emphasize the hollow victory. No triumphalism.
